title: Dread Warren round 8: more entrances on what the game already makes, textured, a modern shaft
desc: J on v2.0114 W1a7a-c: "all three are good, more scenarios like this, perfect utilization of existing generations ... can you attempt updated themed modern looking shafts ... the cave would need texturing". W1a8a-b: the mine inside and the ravine with pixel textures; W1a8c a modern shaft (steel, concrete, cable, dead lamps); W1a9a a dungeon cracked into ours; W1a9b a dripstone cave with ours behind the stalagmites. In the game these are the game's own blocks, so they take Minecraft's textures.

takes.name: Textured: inside a mine, where it becomes ours
takes.facts: W1a7c with pixel textures (oak planks, stone with ore, rails, gravel); ours in dark textured stone. In the game these are the game's own blocks, so they take Minecraft's textures and your pack
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a8a Textured: inside a mine, where it becomes ours

takes.name: Textured: a ravine through a mineshaft
takes.facts: W1a7b with pixel textures: grass, dirt, stone, the mine's planks and rails, from the plank bridge
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a8b Textured: a ravine through a mineshaft

takes.name: Modern shaft
takes.facts: J: "can you attempt updated themed modern looking shafts": a modern mine shaft (steel frames, a concrete lining, a cable run along the roof, a rail, lamps all but dead); at its end the concrete stops and our round dark tunnel goes on down

takes.name: Dungeon broken into ours
takes.facts: more scenarios on what the game already makes: a plain dungeon (cobblestone and mossy cobblestone, a spawner, two chests) whose far wall has cracked open, rubble on the floor, onto our round tunnel
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a9a Dungeon broken into ours

takes.name: Dripstone cave, ours behind the stalagmites
takes.facts: a dripstone cave as the game makes them, pointed dripstone hanging and rising; at the foot of the far wall, behind the stalagmites, our round tunnel
takes.cam3p: Cam W1a9b Dripstone cave, ours behind the stalagmites
